authority.downstream_route: transported CurveRegion2 -> CurveRegion2::offset -> existing offset_exact_general_raw -> existing regularized_region_raw
authority.cache_scope: One stack-owned BezierAlgebraicCuspSemicircleSimilarityCache2 spans all loops and retained fragments of one transform operation. Its vectors remain empty until selected-circle evidence is encountered and are discarded when the operation returns.
authority.cache_keys: Frame, carrier, and overlap reuse requires exact Arc identity. Mapped-parameter reuse additionally includes the source carrier, preventing stale reuse when a parameter wrapper is observed against a different circle authority.
authority.structural_fallback: Independently transformed overlap objects can still share authority when their original overlap authority, transformed carriers, topology, and policy all agree exactly.
authority.nested_transform_rule: SimilarityTransport is flattened to the original overlap proof while the carrier images accumulate the composed exact similarities.
authority.reflection_rule: A reflection reverses each transported carrier orientation consistently and preserves the overlap's relative orientation while changing the signed offset side as required by CurveRegion2 topology.
authority.unsupported_map_rule: Unsupported mapped authorities do not replay stale geometry; they retain the existing guarded failure or complete fallback behavior.

policy_evidence.strict: Similarity transport consists of exact Real affine arithmetic and exact retained authority. Any later equality or ordering that cannot be certified remains unresolved under STRICT.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: The transported proof enters the same operation policy graph. Only existing terminal policy comparators may consume a 512-bit equality or ordering interpretation, and the enclosing CurveOutcome records Approximate512Consumed.
policy_evidence.certified_fixtures: Translation, scaled rotation plus translation, reflection, nested transforms, public transform-then-offset, and cyclic/reversed partitions complete as Certified under both policies when their retained facts are exact.
policy_evidence.unsupported_fixture: A deliberately unsupported stale mapped parameter continues to decline geometric replay under both policies rather than being mistaken for a transported coincident-circle proof.

benchmark_method.fixture: One exact selected circle represented by two semicircles, with the first semicircle partitioned at an independently selected coincident-overlap parameter; the region is transformed by the exact similarity (x,y) -> (5-2y,-3+2x), then measured either during transform or during an exact unit offset.
benchmark_method.controls: exact_partition has the same fragment count with an exact 1/2 cut; unsplit has no internal upper-semicircle partition; disabled retains fixture construction and loop observation without the measured operation.
benchmark_method.wall_method: Seven fresh-process taskset CPU 11 samples per exact variant; 4096 timed operations, 257 warm-ups, and one preflight.
benchmark_method.matched_comparison: The current and detached semantic pre-optimization executables have the same driver modes, release settings, dependency revisions, and complete similarity-transport semantics. The detached benchmark-only commit does not alter production behavior from 566d446.
benchmark_method.perf_method: perf stat user-space instructions, cycles, branches, branch misses, and cache misses over 4096 timed operations, 257 warm-ups, and one preflight, pinned to CPU 11.
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the corresponding disabled process and divide by 4354 operation invocations.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack record-only processes use 512 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight. Subtract the corresponding disabled-process recorder counts and divide by 514; heaptrack_print supplies peak heap.
benchmark_method.competitive_caveat: Cavalier Contours operates on a two-vertex binary64 bulge polyline. It has no exact selected fields, policy outcomes, retained correlation evidence, or certified CurveRegion2 regularization, so its numbers are context rather than equivalent speedups.
benchmark_method.historical_caveat: The historical transform merely cloned stale map evidence and therefore did less work. Its full-region offset happens to succeed only because coalescing removes the stale internal partition before replay; this does not establish historical mapped-parameter transport correctness.

matched_wall_performance.interpretation: The retained mapped-authority cost is only 3.48% over an equal-fragment exact partition during transform, and its downstream offset is statistically indistinguishable from the unsplit exact-circle control.

historical_and_competitive_context.interpretation: Historical stale-clone latency is not a valid semantic target, and Cavalier is a useful floating-point throughput sentinel rather than an exactness-equivalent competitor.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: Instruction and branch reductions confirm algorithmic sharing. Miss counters for the short transform-only process are noisy and can invert; the transformed-offset path shows large reductions across every counter.

allocation_evidence.peak_interpretation: Mapped transform peak increment over its disabled fixture falls from 29.29 KiB to 25.66 KiB. Mapped transformed-offset peak increment falls from 56.74 KiB to 0.29 KiB.
allocation_evidence.memory_interpretation: The operation-local vectors trade a few small cache entries for eliminating independently reconstructed exact polynomial authorities and all their downstream comparison state. No cache survives the operation or enlarges the public CurveRegion2 layout.

no_default_features_with_comparative_dep.interpretation: Predicates-disabled total allocated sections are four bytes smaller despite a 716-byte text increase because data and BSS shrink.

static_callgraph.caveat: The utility is a syntax-level navigation and source-complexity graph, not runtime reachability or linked-size evidence.
